info.title: AquaTome owner's dashboard
info.description:
The owner's dashboard (/_ab/ on the site) as JSON, for the iOS app to draw natively (apps/site/worker/owner-api.ts). The server drives it: the dashboard lists its sections, each section is a title and a list of blocks, and each button says the request it makes, so a new section, block or button needs no app release.

Only the owner: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, the token a sign-in with client "app" returns (protocols/accounts.openapi.json), of an account the server's OWNER_ACCOUNTS names. Without a live app session, every path answers 401 `signed_out`, as the accounts API does: no Authorization, a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token sent as a bearer, the build's dashboard token, or a cookie (the web pages at /_ab/ stay cookie-only; a cookie never opens these paths). Sign in again. Another account's app session gets 404 `not_found`, as for a path that doesn't exist. Both come before any other check, so a path, a method or a key tells nobody else anything. Every reply is `cache-control: no-store` and `x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow`.

Text comes written as the web pages write it: Vietnamese, numbers formatted (1.234, 12,5%, $0,11), days and times in the viewer's zone (the `Time-Zone` header). A chart's numbers stay raw (see Chart). Show text as it comes; don't parse it.

Reading: the app skips a block whose `kind` it doesn't know (the section's web page, /_ab/{key}/, has everything), and ignores fields it doesn't know. A block, a section or a field may be added at any time; one is removed or changed only with a new version of this contract.

Links: a cell's `href` and a photo's `src` that start with a single "/" are on https://aquatome.com: a cell's opens the site's page; a photo's is a private image the app fetches with the same bearer. Send the bearer only for a `src` that starts with a single "/", to aquatome.com, never for one that starts with "//". A `src` that is a whole address is public: fetch it without the bearer.

Buttons (Action): send `method` to `path` with the bearer and, when there is a `body`, that body as JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`). On 200, read the section again. On an error, show its `message` when it has one. A form block is the same with fields: its fields' values (by `name`) and its `body` go as one JSON object. A switch block reads the section again from its `href`. An actions block is buttons on their own.

Errors are `{error, message?}`: `message`, when there is one, is Vietnamese to show the owner. Any path may answer 503 `unavailable` when the server can't read or write its storage just then (D1, KV, R2): try again later.

Samples: protocols/owner-dashboard-vectors.json has a reply of each path, from the Worker's own code, for the app's fake server.

get.summary: The overview: what needs the owner, each area's figure, and the sections

parameters.name: Time-Zone
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, as the phone has it (TimeZone.current.identifier): the reply's days and times are in it. Absent, or one the server doesn't know: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The reply says which it used (`tz`).

200.description: The overview, as the /_ab/ page shows it.

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

get.summary: One section of the dashboard, as blocks

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A section's key, as the dashboard's `sections` lists them: the /_ab/ page's path name (/_ab/noi-dung/ → noi-dung). Today's keys are listed here; take them from the dashboard rather than from this list.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: ung-dung only: "1" counts only our own test builds (debug, TestFlight), as the web page's link does; without it, only readers' builds. The section's switch block gives the address with it flipped.

parameters.name: Time-Zone
parameters.description: The viewer's IANA time zone, as the phone has it (TimeZone.current.identifier): the reply's days and times are in it. Absent, or one the server doesn't know: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. The reply says which it used (`tz`).

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path; or a key that isn't a section)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

post.summary: A reader's photo: approve one waiting (the next moderation pass publishes it, without its checks) or remove one now (waiting or shown)

200.description: Done. `changed`: false when there was nothing to do (approve: the photo no longer waits; remove: it was already removed, or never was).

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, or no `action` of the two)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (readers' photos aren't set up on this server, or the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

post.summary: Hide a page from the site (410, then out of lists, the sitemap and search), or bring it back

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, or the fields aren't these) | not_a_page (`path` isn't one page of the site, or is a home page; `message` says so)

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then; try again)

delete.summary: Delete a photo a reader let the fish identifier keep

parameters.name: who
parameters.description: The account that sent it, or `anon` (sent signed out), as the photo's Delete button says.

200.description: Done. `changed`: false when there was no such photo.

401.description: Error: signed_out (no live app session: no Authorization or a malformed one, a session that ended or was signed out, a web session's token, the dashboard token, a cookie)

404.description: Error: not_found (another account's app session; no such path)

503.description: Error: unavailable (no photo storage on this server, or the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

get.summary: A waiting reader photo's upload (a photos block's `src`), while it waits
get.description: The same address the web page shows; it takes the owner's app bearer too. Private: never stored (`cache-control: private, no-store`), never indexed (`x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow`).

200.description: The image as sent (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

404.description: Not the owner (signed out too: these stay 404, never 401), or the photo no longer waits (text, not JSON).

get.summary: A kept fish-ID photo (a photos block's `src`)
get.description: The same address the web page shows; it takes the owner's app bearer too. Private: never stored, never indexed (`x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow`).

404.description: Not the owner (signed out too: these stay 404, never 401), or no such photo (text, not JSON).

post.summary: The daily report's delivery: email, the phones' notifications, or both, on or off (the `bao-cao` section's buttons send it). Unset, email is on and notifications off. The notifications switch is the server's: off, no phone is notified, registered or not.

200.description: The settings as they are now; `changed`: false when they already were so.

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, no switch, a switch that isn't true or false, or another field; `message`: "email và/hoặc push (true/false).")

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

post.summary: This phone gets the daily report's notification: the app's own row ("Nhận thông báo trên máy này") sends it at each launch while on, and when turned on. An upsert: the same token again moves its last-seen time. The server keeps the 10 phones seen last, each tied to the app session that posted it last (it stores the session's id, never the bearer), and before each report drops every token whose session is no longer live, and any APNs answers 410 or 400 BadDeviceToken for.

200.description: Kept. `changed`: the token is new here, its environment changed, or it moved to this session (false when only its time moved).

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, a token that isn't lowercase hex of 16 to 100 bytes, an environment that isn't one of the two, or another field; `message`: what it takes)

405.description: Error: method (not POST or DELETE; `allow: POST, DELETE`)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

delete.summary: This phone gets no more notifications: sent when the row is turned off, and before the owner signs out.

400.description: Error: bad_request (not JSON, a token that isn't lowercase hex of 16 to 100 bytes, or another field: it takes `token` alone)

405.description: Error: method (not POST or DELETE; `allow: POST, DELETE`)

503.description: Error: unavailable (the server couldn't read or write its storage just then)

bearer.description: The app: the token from a sign-in with client "app" (protocols/accounts.openapi.json), of the owner's account.

Tz.description: The IANA time zone the reply's days and times are in.

todos.description: What needs the owner now, most pressing first; empty when nothing does (the web page says "Không có việc gì cần bạn lúc này.").

areas.description: One row an area, in the page's order.

areasNote.description: The note under the areas: what the figures and chips compare.

sections.description: Every section, in the web dashboard's order and with its names: the app's list of what it can open.

TodoAction.description: Where to deal with it: a section (by key), or an address elsewhere (a GitHub run) to open in the browser.

anchor.description: Where in the section: the `anchor` of one of its headings. Open the section scrolled to it.

section.description: The section it opens (and `anchor`, where in it).

fig.description: Its figure, written ("1.234", "—" when it couldn't load).

sub.description: What the figure counts, or why it couldn't load.

spark.description: The 30 whole days before today, oldest first, as small columns: the last 7 are the figure's days, the 7 before them the chip's comparison. null: a day not recorded (draw nothing). Empty: no columns for this area.

anchor.description: Where in the section: the `anchor` of one of its headings. Open the section scrolled to it.

text.description: "+18%", or the difference itself while counts are small ("+4").

vs.description: What it compares with, for VoiceOver: "so với {vs}".

Log.description: What happened over the last days, newest day first: the web page's "Mấy ngày qua".

entries.description: Each day's entries, newest day first. A day with nothing new is one entry, tone muted. Group them by `at`.

at.description: The day, written in the viewer's zone ("Hôm nay · 04/11 · chưa hết ngày", "Hôm qua · 03/11", "Thứ Hai · 02/11"); the same for every entry of that day.

tone.description: plain: ordinary text; muted: secondary, or an empty state; good: done, better; bad: needs the owner, failed, worse, or (a button) deletes.

section.description: The section it opens, when there is one.

url.description: Or an address elsewhere, to open in the browser.

Block.description: One part of a section, by `kind`. A part that couldn't load is a note (tone bad) in its place; the rest of the section still comes.

level.description: 2: a part of the section; 3: a part within it.

anchor.description: The name a to-do, an area or a log entry gives as `anchor` to open the section here (the web page's #id).

meter.description: A share of a whole, drawn as a thin bar under the figure (the text says the figure).

tone.description: plain: ordinary text; muted: secondary, or an empty state; good: done, better; bad: needs the owner, failed, worse, or (a button) deletes.

Chart.description: Columns over days, as the web page's charts (apps/site/worker/admin/chart.ts DayChart): stacked from the baseline in the series' order, a negative value below it; `whole` a pale column behind them. Values are raw numbers; write them as the section's text writes numbers (vi-VN grouping), money with `unit`.

days.description: Oldest first, in the viewer's zone (or Vietnam's, where the data keeps Vietnam's days: the section's notes say so).

unit.description: usd: dollars, "$0,11", and "$0,0042" below a cent. Absent: counts.

partialLast.description: The last day is today, not over yet: drawn lighter.

empty.description: What to say when every value is 0 or missing.

missing.description: Why a null day has no value.

values.description: One per day; null: the day wasn't recorded.

tone.description: Absent: s1, s2, s3 by position. bad: the status colour; mute: context only.

rows.description: Each row has a cell per column; the first names the row.

empty.description: What to show when there are no rows.

folded.description: Drawn closed, opened by this label (the web page's disclosure).

href.description: A page of the site, from "/" (open it as the app opens the site's pages).

tone.description: plain: ordinary text; muted: secondary, or an empty state; good: done, better; bad: needs the owner, failed, worse, or (a button) deletes.
plain: ordinary text; muted: secondary, or an empty state; good: done, better; bad: needs the owner, failed, worse, or (a button) deletes.

src.description: From "/": private, fetch it with the bearer. A whole address: public.

Hidden.description: Pages taken down, newest first. Hide another with POST /api/owner/hidden.

note.description: Why, as the owner wrote it.

Form.description: A form: on submit, send `method` to `path` as an Action does, with the fields' values (each under its `name`; an empty optional field left out) and `body` as one JSON object.

body.description: Sent with the fields, as it is.

label.description: What the field asks, for the label or VoiceOver.

Switch.description: A switch between two forms of the section: show it `on` or off; flipping it reads the section from `href` and shows that instead.

href.description: The section with the switch flipped: GET it with the bearer.

Actions.description: Buttons on their own, in a row (a setting's on and off): each makes its request as an Action does, then the section is read again.

Action.description: A button: the request it makes.

body.description: Sent as JSON, as it is.

tone.description: plain: ordinary text; muted: secondary, or an empty state; good: done, better; bad: needs the owner, failed, worse, or (a button) deletes.

path.description: The page: a path or a whole address on the site, in any language ("/ca/x/", "https://aquatome.com/id/ikan/x/").

hide.description: true: hide it; false: bring it back.

path.description: The page as the list keeps it.

token.description: The APNs device token as lowercase hex (64 digits today).

environment.description: `sandbox` from debug builds, `production` from TestFlight and App Store builds: the APNs host the server sends to.

token.description: The APNs device token as lowercase hex (64 digits today).
